approval_scope: Lucas authorized final checks, offline slicing and hardware/performance scenario calculations, conditional on checks; no printing, uploads, purchases or hardware operation
purpose: Per-piece approval proposal for an offline standard-size reference mass estimate, not final scale or manufacturing release
reference_printer: Bambu P2S, standard-flow 0.4 mm nozzle, enclosed; needs Lucas confirmation
bed_reference: ASA Aero: manufacturer-listed Engineering/High Temperature plate with glue; exact P2S-compatible plate unconfirmed. Reference 90 C. PC compatible manufacturer-listed plate/glue at 100 C. No physical setup authorized
release_gates: Lucas approves this reference recipe and printer/nozzle/scale assumptions
Resolve material and process profile inheritance to exact installed printer and nozzle branch
Verify numeric orientations from original manufacturing geometry against manual pictures
Separate physical bodies from STEP modifiers and verify regional overlap, including right-wing counterpart registration
Verify lateral-lattice availability in installed Bambu Studio; do not silently substitute grid or gyroid
Verify supports/brims and all slicing errors in preview; propose any construction changes for approval
mass_limits: Future results must be labeled uncalibrated sliced estimates until print-and-weigh validation
Raw filament density and deposition flow are used exactly once; do not apply foamed density reduction again
Part mass must exclude detachable supports/brims/purge and be separate from manufacturing consumption
One approved printer profile does not prove harsh-temperature service or payload capability

grid100_to99.scope: Replace previously100%-grid Stork recipes with99% grid; all other patterns/densities unchanged; not physical-print authorization
